alt: Escritorio de madera con carpetas contables ordenadas y una lámpara, en una oficina con vista a Ciudad de Panamá
escena: A tidy wooden desk in a quiet accounting office with neatly stacked binders, a desk lamp and a coffee cup, large window behind showing the Panama City skyline softly out of focus at golden hour.

alt: Mano sosteniendo un teléfono móvil sobre un escritorio con una libreta abierta, lista para escribir
escena: Close-up of a hand holding a smartphone over an office desk with an open notebook and a pen, as if about to send a message, soft daylight, blurred modern office in Panama City behind.

alt: Calculadora, recibos de pago y lápiz sobre un escritorio, preparando el cálculo del Seguro Social
escena: Top-down view of a desk with a calculator, a few payroll slips with blurred unreadable lines, a pencil and reading glasses, clean composition with soft shadows.

alt: Mesa de reuniones con documentos contables y una laptop, preparada para revisar las cuentas de una empresa
escena: A small meeting table in a bright Panama City office with a laptop, a folder of financial documents and two coffee cups, ready for a client review meeting, nobody present.

alt: Taza de café junto a un cuaderno con notas y una tablet sobre una mesa, un momento para leer con calma
escena: A calm reading moment: a cup of coffee, an open notebook with illegible handwritten notes and a tablet on a wooden table next to a window with tropical plants outside.

alt: Archivador con un cajón abierto y carpetas desordenadas, como un documento que no está donde se esperaba
escena: A metal filing cabinet with one drawer half open and a few folders slightly out of place, soft moody light in an empty office corridor.

alt: Emprendedora de espaldas abriendo la persiana de su pequeño local en una calle de Ciudad de Panamá
escena: A small business owner seen from behind raising the metal shutter of a tiny new shop on a colorful street in Panama City in the early morning.

alt: Interior de una pyme panameña con estanterías de inventario y un mostrador con caja registradora
escena: Interior of a small Panamanian family business: shelves with inventory boxes, a counter with a cash register and a laptop, warm light, no people in focus.

alt: Maleta y pasaporte junto a una carpeta de documentos, con el skyline de Ciudad de Panamá al fondo
escena: A carry-on suitcase, a closed passport and a folder of documents on a hotel desk by a window overlooking the Panama City skyline and the bay.

alt: Terminal de punto de venta emitiendo un comprobante en el mostrador de un comercio
escena: A modern point-of-sale terminal on a shop counter printing a small receipt, a tablet showing an abstract invoice layout without readable text, shallow depth of field.

alt: Mapa del mundo difuminado detrás de documentos financieros y una calculadora, operaciones entre empresas de distintos países
escena: Financial reports and a calculator on a glass desk, with a softly blurred world map on the wall behind, suggesting operations between related companies in different countries.

alt: Contenedores apilados en un puerto panameño al atardecer, imagen de la actividad logística y las zonas francas
escena: Stacked shipping containers at a Panamanian port near Colón at sunset, cranes in the background, wide view.

alt: Fachada de pequeños comercios en una calle de Ciudad de Panamá con toldos de colores
escena: A row of small shopfronts with colorful awnings on a street in Panama City, midday light, no readable signs.

alt: Sobre de pago, calculadora y una lista de conceptos sobre el escritorio de una pequeña empresa
escena: A pay envelope, a calculator and a sheet with a blurred list of line items on a small business desk, a hand pointing at the sheet.

alt: Calendario de pared con un día marcado en rojo y un reloj, el plazo de una declaración que se pasó
escena: A paper wall calendar with one day circled in red marker next to a wall clock, office background out of focus.

alt: Dos caminos marcados sobre una mesa con dos carpetas distintas, la decisión entre persona natural y sociedad
escena: Two different folders, one plain and one formal with a ribbon, lying side by side on a table with a fountain pen between them, suggesting a choice.

alt: Recibos de gastos ordenados por categorías junto a una laptop sobre un escritorio
escena: Business expense receipts sorted into neat small piles with paper clips next to a laptop, top-down view, clean desk.

alt: Reunión entre dos personas vistas desde las manos, revisando documentos juntos en una mesa
escena: Over-the-shoulder view of two people's hands reviewing documents together at a table, one pointing at a page, faces out of frame.

alt: Cajas de archivo con papeles acumulados en una esquina de la oficina, contabilidad atrasada
escena: Cardboard archive boxes overflowing with papers stacked in the corner of a small office, afternoon light through blinds.

alt: Carpeta de estados financieros sobre el mostrador de una sucursal bancaria
escena: A neat folder of financial statements placed on a bank branch desk, modern bank interior in Panama City blurred behind.

alt: Ticket de compra y datáfono en el mostrador de una tienda en Panamá
escena: A shopping receipt and a card payment terminal on the counter of a small store in Panama, shopper's hand reaching for the receipt.

alt: Oficina vacía con persianas bajadas y una carpeta cubierta de polvo sobre el escritorio
escena: An empty, unused office with closed blinds and a single dusty folder on a desk, quiet atmosphere.

alt: Vista del skyline de Ciudad de Panamá desde la Cinta Costera con una persona de espaldas
escena: A person seen from behind with a backpack looking at the Panama City skyline from the Cinta Costera waterfront promenade in the morning.

alt: Alcancía de cerámica sobre un escritorio junto a un calendario, la idea de apartar dinero cada mes
escena: A ceramic piggy bank on an office desk beside a desk calendar and a few coins, soft natural light.

alt: Lupa sobre un libro contable impreso con una zona marcada en amarillo, buscando señales de un problema
escena: Close-up of a hand holding a magnifying glass over a printed financial ledger with blurred columns, one area highlighted with a yellow marker.

alt: Mostrador de una ferretería en Panamá con una impresora térmica sacando un comprobante junto a un lector de tarjetas
escena: Close-up of a hardware store counter in Panama City where a small thermal printer is feeding out a blank receipt next to a card terminal, shelves of tools softly blurred behind. Warm afternoon light, no legible text or logos.

alt: Manos de una persona revisando una planilla impresa con una calculadora y un bolígrafo sobre un escritorio de madera
escena: Overhead shot of hands comparing two stacks of printed payroll sheets with a desk calculator and a pen on a wooden desk in a small Panama City office, blurred rows of figures, no legible text. Soft window light with a hint of palm trees outside.

alt: Sobre de papel, una carpeta y una caja de cartón con objetos personales sobre una mesa de oficina al terminar la jornada
escena: A cardboard box holding a mug, a small plant and a folded jacket sits on an empty office desk next to a closed manila envelope and a folder, late evening light through blinds in a Panama City office. No people, no legible text.

alt: Carpetas de expedientes de personal ordenadas en un archivador metálico abierto, algunas más gastadas que otras
escena: An open metal filing cabinet drawer full of personnel folders of different ages, some worn and yellowed, others crisp and new, in a quiet Panamanian office storeroom. Shallow depth of field, tabs unreadable.

alt: Persona de espaldas esperando en la sala de una oficina pública de Ciudad de Panamá con una carpeta bajo el brazo
escena: A person seen from behind waiting in a government office lobby in Panama City, holding a document folder under the arm, rows of plastic chairs and a service counter softly blurred ahead. Natural daylight, no readable signs.

alt: Fachada de un pequeño comercio en una calle de Ciudad de Panamá con la persiana metálica a medio subir por la mañana
escena: Early morning on a street in Panama City: a small corner shop with its metal rolling shutter half raised, a hand pushing it up, colorful facade and sidewalk tiles, no legible signage or logos.

alt: Manos abriendo un sobre oficial sobre la mesa de una cocina, junto a una taza de café y un teléfono boca abajo
escena: Close-up of hands opening an official-looking envelope at a kitchen table in a Panama City apartment, a cup of coffee and a face-down phone nearby, morning light. The letter inside is folded and unreadable.

alt: Fachada de un pequeño comercio en una calle del Casco Antiguo de Ciudad de Panamá con la persiana a medio abrir
escena: Editorial photo of a small shopfront on a colonial street in Casco Antiguo, Panama City, early morning, the metal shutter half raised and a folder of paperwork resting on the counter inside. No readable signage, no people.

alt: Dos carpetas de documentos unidas por un clip sobre una mesa de reuniones con vista a los rascacielos de Panamá
escena: Editorial photo of two separate document folders connected by a single binder clip on a glass meeting table, with the blurred skyline of Punta Pacifica, Panama City, behind the window. No readable text, no people.

alt: Pasillo de una bodega en la Zona Libre de Colón con cajas apiladas y un portapapeles sobre una tarima
escena: Editorial photo inside a warehouse in the Colon Free Zone, Panama, tall shelves of stacked cardboard boxes and a clipboard resting on a wooden pallet in the foreground, soft industrial light. No readable labels or logos, no people.

alt: Escritorio con carpetas ordenadas por mes, calculadora y comprobantes agrupados con clips, luz de tarde
escena: Editorial overhead photo of an office desk in Panama City with a row of monthly folders, stacks of receipts grouped with paper clips and a desk calculator, warm late-afternoon light from a window with blinds. No readable text, no faces.

alt: Manos marcando con un lápiz un estado de cuenta impreso junto a un libro contable abierto
escena: Close-up editorial photo of hands ticking lines with a pencil on a printed bank statement laid next to an open ledger, on a wooden desk in a Panama City office. Text blurred and unreadable, no faces.

alt: Caja registradora casi vacía en un mini súper panameño con facturas por cobrar sujetas junto al mostrador
escena: Editorial photo of a nearly empty open cash drawer at the counter of a small neighborhood minimarket in Panama City, with a spike of unpaid invoices beside it and blurred shelves of goods behind. No readable text, no people.

alt: Oficina pequeña con un escritorio vacío y su silla, y al fondo una persona de espaldas en una videollamada
escena: Editorial photo of a small office in Panama City with an empty desk and chair in the foreground, and in the soft-focus background a person seen from behind on a video call on a laptop. No readable screen content, no recognizable faces.

alt: Manos colocando recibos de papel en carpetas separadas por mes sobre el mostrador de una ferretería en Panamá
escena: Close-up of hands sorting paper receipts into a row of labeled accordion folders (labels blank, no readable text) on the wooden counter of a small hardware store in Panama City, shelves of tools softly blurred behind. Natural afternoon light, realistic editorial photography.

alt: Café y hojas impresas con gráficos sin texto legible sobre una mesa junto a una ventana con vista a Ciudad de Panamá
escena: Printed financial report pages with simple bar and line charts (no legible numbers or text) spread on a small table beside a cup of Panamanian coffee and a pen, early morning light through a window overlooking the Panama City skyline. Realistic editorial photography, shallow depth of field.

alt: Persona de espaldas revisando archivadores en una sala de reuniones de una empresa en Ciudad de Panamá
escena: A person seen from behind pulling a binder from a shelf of neatly stacked archive boxes in a glass-walled meeting room of a mid-size company office in Panama City, a table with open binders in the foreground. Cool daylight, realistic editorial photography, no readable labels.

alt: Dos contratos en blanco sobre un escritorio de oficina con una pluma entre ambos, en Panamá
escena: Top-down view of two separate blank contract documents (no legible text) lying side by side on a teak office desk in Panama, a fountain pen resting between them and a hand hovering over one, potted tropical plant at the edge of frame. Warm natural light, realistic editorial photography.

alt: Profesional independiente de espaldas trabajando en un portátil en una terraza del Casco Antiguo de Panamá
escena: A freelancer seen from behind working on a laptop (screen blurred) at a small café table on a balcony in Casco Antiguo, Panama City, with a folder of receipts beside a glass of water and colonial facades softly out of focus. Late afternoon golden light, realistic editorial photography.

alt: Manos entregando una caja de archivo con carpetas a otras manos en una oficina de Panamá
escena: Close-up of one pair of hands passing a cardboard archive box full of folders to another pair of hands across a reception desk in a modest office in Panama City, a USB drive resting on top of the folders. Soft indoor light, realistic editorial photography, no faces or readable text.
